observations: Three photos show a used car engine, likely removed from a vehicle.
The engine has a black intake manifold, visible belts, pulleys, and various hoses and connectors.
Photo 2 shows a small white label with a barcode and text on the engine block, but the text is too blurry to read.
The engine appears to be in a workshop or storage area, with other parts visible in the background.
No visible branding or model name on the engine block or components in any photo.
The seller claims it is a 'Toyota Avalon 3MZ highest grade one, tokunbo'.

claims.claim: Toyota Avalon 3MZ highest grade one, tokunbo
claims.evidence: No visible branding or model name on the engine in any photo. The label in photo 2 is too blurry to read. The seller's text is not verifiable from the images.

risks.risk: Engine may not be from a Toyota Avalon or may not be a 3MZ model.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the engine block with visible model number or casting mark, or a photo of the label in photo 2 with readable text.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used engine, not as a specific Toyota Avalon 3MZ.

risks.risk: Engine may be damaged or non-functional.
risks.proof: Video or photo showing the engine running or a mechanic's inspection report.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working or in unknown condition.

risks.risk: Engine may have been salvaged from a wrecked or accident-damaged vehicle.
risks.proof: Photo of the vehicle's VIN plate or documentation showing the source vehicle's condition.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a salvaged engine, with lower value.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the engine block showing the model number or casting mark.
Photo of the label in photo 2 with readable text.
Video or photo showing the engine running.
Photo of the vehicle's VIN plate or documentation of the source vehicle.
response.reason: The engine cannot be identified as a Toyota Avalon 3MZ from the current photos. The seller's claim is unverified, and critical risks (model authenticity, condition, source) cannot be assessed without additional proof. A price cannot be determined without confirming the model and condition.
